mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle (id, vehicle_code, license_plate, capacity_weight, capacity_volume, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{vehicleCode}, #{licensePlate}, #{capacityWeight}, #{capacityVolume}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, vehicle_code, license_plate, capacity_weight, capacity_volume, status, created_at, updated_at FROM vehicle ORDER BY vehicle_code ASC
SELECT id, vehicle_code, license_plate, capacity_weight, capacity_volume, status, created_at, updated_at FROM vehicle WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY vehicle_code ASC
SELECT * FROM vehicle WHERE status = 'AVAILABLE' AND ((ownership_type = 'SHIPPER' AND owner_shipper_id = #{shipperId}) OR (ownership_type = 'HUB' AND hub_id = #{hubId})) ORDER BY vehicle_code
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle SET status = 'IN_USE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' AND ((ownership_type = 'SHIPPER' AND owner_shipper_id = #{shipperId}) OR (ownership_type = 'HUB' AND hub_id = #{hubId}))
UPDATE vehicle SET status = 'AVAILABLE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'IN_USE'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vehicle WHERE id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'IN_USE' AND ((ownership_type = 'SHIPPER' AND owner_shipper_id = #{shipperId}) OR (ownership_type = 'HUB' AND hub_id = #{hubId}))
